labels.name: Segmentation
labels.definition: Divide an object, system, process, or responsibility into independent or differently managed parts so the desired improvement becomes possible.

labels.name: Inversion
labels.definition: Reverse an action, arrangement, sequence, direction, role, or operating condition so the desired improvement becomes possible.

abstention.name: Abstain
abstention.definition: Neither operator fits the stated transformation confidently enough for a forced choice.

decision_rule: Choose the operator that most directly characterizes the stated transformation, not merely the problem domain or vocabulary. Record an abstention when neither definition can be applied confidently.
